Concentrates in NYC

Concentrates are the smallest smokable category on New York menus, with about 1,320 listings across the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, from 112 brands. The term covers everything extracted from flower and meant for a dab rig or vaporizer: live resin, live rosin, budder, cured resin, diamonds, hash and RSO syringes. MFNY dominates with 205 listings, more than the next three brands combined, followed by RYTHM and Hudson Cannabis at 79 each, Olio at 73, Static Room at 59 and Umamii at 54.

Prices start at $20, with most grams between $30 and $65 before tax depending on the extraction. Solventless live rosin from brands like A1 Ducksauce sits at the top of that range; cured resin and budder sit near the bottom. Midtown has by far the deepest selection at 184 listings, led by Qube's 70-item case, with Sheepshead Bay at 129, Chelsea and Flatiron at 127 and Bushwick at 99. Most shops carry only a handful, so if you dab regularly, the large Midtown and south Brooklyn menus are where to look.

Concentrates FAQ
What is the difference between live resin and live rosin?

Both start with flower frozen at harvest. Live resin is extracted with a solvent like butane, then purged; live rosin uses only ice water, heat and pressure. Rosin costs more and is sold by brands like A1 Ducksauce; MFNY and Olio are the main live resin makers in New York.

How much concentrate can I buy?

New York's possession limit is 24 grams of concentrate, separate from the three-ounce flower limit. Dispensaries sell single grams and occasionally half-grams, so the limit rarely matters in practice.

Which dispensary has the most concentrates?

Qube in Midtown, with about 70 listings. Gotham Chelsea, Culture House, Buzzy in Brooklyn Heights and Grams in Williamsburg each carry cases of 23 to 30.
